design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use ILSA achievement data as an outcome or predictor, focusing instead on clustering student profiles.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Recorded evidence does not explicitly establish an unweighted analysis. Original extraction rationale: The study does not report the use of PISA sampling/student weights, indicating that the analysis was likely unweighted.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study employs clustering methods without mentioning any multilevel modeling or consideration of school-level clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The excerpts do not provide any information about validation strategies beyond the estimation sample.
